scope: Research service model for the unchanged ordinary and lifting raw students. Local complete-K numerical checks plus explicit full-domain projection BN completion; not RTL, PPA, a new deployment, or a whole-network speedup.

arithmetic.FP32_contract: Common eight-lane FMA/add issue, latency four, II one; chosen before any full-chain service result to admit the stronger ordinary baseline. Actual CUDA capture permits TF32 convolutions; precision/rounding remains a numerical-validation gap, not a new integer preview. Gate-times-one may omit the exact multiply only after checking actual theta.
arithmetic.source_program: Existing common fused two-stage source, same static compiler choices and 96-word RF; all 35 intermediate lifting RNE/sat remain.

schedule.reuse: K-major source and coefficient broadcast across the actual active T10/P2 destinations; full K, static coefficient zeros and padding omitted identically. No partial-sum pattern sharing switch.
schedule.source_input: Input raw I24 is immutable external memory, original T,C,y,x packed signed24. A spatial row is staged; retained raw residuals are reread and charged. No free full-frame on-chip I.
schedule.phase_barrier: A gate tile is available only after its producer, complete noncausal time reduction and SRAM write. Native projection normalization cannot complete before the entire actual BN statistics domain.
schedule.native_weight_tiling: H32 at a time: 864*32*4=110592 bytes, below common 128KiB. Refills and repeated input reads are charged; no 331776-byte resident weight assumption.
schedule.baseline_privileges: Same source constant CSE/cutoff/fusion, same source-zero and weight-zero skipping, same local-state and request reuse, same arithmetic/ports/DMA. This is not yet a complete official GustavSNN reproduction.

no_free_statistics: Captured full-domain means and variances are numerical verification data only. A local block supplied with them is not a closed hardware endpoint; measured full-domain statistics/replay costs must be shown separately until connected.

ATLIF_inference_contract.theta: fixed at inference; actual captured module parameters retained
ATLIF_inference_contract.weight_folding: Allowed: W_prime=theta*W for linear consumers; apply per input channel if appropriate
ATLIF_inference_contract.runtime_spike_interface: one-bit g; no arbitrary per-event amplitude required
ATLIF_inference_contract.continuous_datapaths: pre-spike PSN, residual I and continuous PED retain their actual arithmetic
ATLIF_inference_contract.effect_on_recorded_results: Identity clarification only; no checkpoint, quantization or numerical result changed
